## Meet Charles.
Charles is running for the United States Senate to fight for a Kentucky that works for all of us. A place where everyone can thrive and dream big again. Kentucky needs a bold vision to address our deepest challenges. A fighter for Kentucky’s working people, Charles is committed to a vision of government that builds a better future for everyone, not just the wealthy.
Charles’s work builds upon Kentucky’s long history of standing up and fighting back against greedy industries and politicians. He stood with miners in Harlan County and social justice organizers from Pike to Jefferson to McCracken. He stands with the people of Kentucky, from the hood to the holler, and it’s why they stand with him.
## Kentucky, it's time for us to turn a new page.
I’m running for Senate because I see the urgency of this moment. I know what’s at stake, but I also know that together we can win. We can build a future that’s worthy of this state and the people who call it home. I know Kentucky is worth fighting for, and I’m proud to be in this fight alongside you.
## Let's win for Kentucky.
With you on our team, we’re going to build a strong movement across the Commonwealth — uniting Kentuckians across race, religion, and class — to win.
